name: LemurSaucePacket
description: A Create-powered SMP that still feels like Minecraft. Build factories, rail networks and airships, explore a reworked world, and fight your way up the ages.

shaderPresets._comment: The launcher shader picker (Settings > Graphics). Iris is always installed with shaders off by default; each preset names a shader pack by its packwiz file (pack/shaderpacks/<shaderpack>.pw.toml), which publish.mjs turns into the zip name. (Key renamed from "shaders" in launcher 0.1.6, so 0.1.5 hides its picker instead of misreading this.)

presets.name: Lite

presets.description: Complementary Reimagined. Keeps the Minecraft look with good shadows, water and sky. Needs a decent graphics card.

news.title: 1.8: The Fight Pits and the Inferno
news.body: After Dragon Slayer I, Guildmaster Greaves sends you to the Kilnfolk, ashen piglins in the volcanic lands. At Kiln Hollow, earn the right to fight in the Fight Pits: thirty waves alone, then Kiln-Tok-Jad, whose fire you block with a shield and whose slam you run from. Win the animated Fire Cape. Then Ashes of the Kiln (the Wither, the Ender Dragon, the Warden and an Infernal Key) opens the Inferno, where Kiln-Kal-Zuk burns everyone his drifting shield does not cover: survive it for the Infernal Cape. Fall in either and you are pulled out with everything you had. Also: the legendary capes are redrawn as proper pixel art, and the custom armour sets look like themselves when worn.

news.title: A new world, and Elvarg's Lair
news.body: The server starts over on a fresh world. Follow the compass you get to Lemurton, a short walk from spawn. Dragon Slayer I now ends in Elvarg's Lair: speak to Ned at the Crandor memorial and fight her alone or with up to three friends; if she gets you, Ned keeps your things. The pack also has a website now, play.limas.ca, with the wiki, a gallery and every update.

news.title: 1.1: Gear, capes and the guide
news.body: The Armory is open: a tree-felling Lumber Axe, an Excavator's 3x3 pickaxe, a Prospector's pickaxe that smelts what it mines, a Harvester's Scythe, a Builder's Wand, three weapons and five armour sets with full-set bonuses (Prospector, Aeronaut, Brass Duelist, Compacted Diamond, Compacted Netherite). All Create-made and skill-gated; the rarest pieces only drop in dungeons. Relics is in, with set synergies. Capes: earn them from skills at 99, finished chapters and real feats; ESC → Capes. And every page of the new wiki is in your inventory as the LemurSaucePacket Guide (ESC → Guide).

news.title: Welcome to LemurSaucePacket
news.body: Press Play. The launcher installs Minecraft, NeoForge and every mod for you, keeps them in sync with the server, and drops you straight in.
